files.CONVENTIONS.md:
# Accepted JSON configuration rule

Every .json file under config/, recursively, must contain valid JSON and must not repeat a decoded member name within one object, at any nesting level including objects inside arrays. Escaped and literal representations of the same name count as equal. The same name in different objects and repeated string values are valid. Files outside config/ are outside this rule. Existing duplicate timeout in config/default.json must be repaired by retaining its current effective value, 10. Report the offending file and member name with a useful correction. There is no suppression mechanism or automatic fixer requirement.

files..github/workflows/check.yml:
name: Local configuration checks
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: make check
